title_zh: A taste of literature — 第39节可背诵讲义
body_en: Stories let you live many lives in one book. Read a short story slowly and mark new feelings. Ask: who wants what, and what stands in the way? Write five sentences that retell the ending in your own words. Good readers notice both the story and the heart.
body_zh: 故事让你在一本书里过许多人生。慢慢读短篇，标出新的感受。问：谁想要什么，什么挡住了路？用五句话按自己的话复述结局。好的读者既看见故事，也看见人心。
